title: Benchmark report presentation style configuration
description: External presentation settings injected via --report-style or load_report_style(). Generated reflectively from benchmarking.reporting.style.ReportStyle so schema and runtime validation stay locked to a single source of truth.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

display_names.description: Optional mapping from canonical JSON algorithm keys to rendered table/figure labels.

decimal_separator.description: Decimal separator used in quantitative LaTeX macros (e.g., '.' or '{,}').

cd_decimal_sep.description: Decimal separator used in Demšar Critical Difference TikZ diagrams (e.g., '.' or ',').

plot_decimal_comma.description: Format Matplotlib y-axis gap/cost tick labels with decimal commas when true.

latex_label_prefix.description: Optional prefix inserted into LaTeX \label{tab:<prefix>...} identifiers.

size_thresholds.description: Two-element [small_max, medium_max] stratum cutoffs satisfying 0 < small_max < medium_max.

show_size_guides.description: Draw vertical problem-size stratum guides on scaling plots when true.

cd_quality_label.description: Metric label for optimality-gap Demšar Critical Difference diagrams.

cd_cost_label.description: Fallback metric label for cost Demšar CD diagrams when reference optima are absent.

cd_time_label.description: Metric label for execution-time Demšar Critical Difference diagrams.

cd_rank_label.description: Axis label placed at the right end of Demšar CD rank axes.

plot_title.description: Main suptitle rendered above the dual-panel scaling figure.

plot_time_ylabel.description: Y-axis label for the top (execution time) scaling panel.

plot_gap_ylabel.description: Y-axis label for the bottom (optimality gap) scaling panel.

plot_cost_ylabel.description: Fallback y-axis label for the bottom panel when reference optima are absent.

plot_xlabel.description: Shared x-axis label for problem dimension n.

plot_band_label.description: Optional legend label for the empirical dispersion band (null uses metric default).

algorithm_order.description: Optional explicit algorithm ordering applied across tables, macros, CD diagrams, and plots.
